_doc: Juice around the board (src/client/fx.ts, view only; the board's own motion and the landing squash are in data/characters.json board and squash). Particles live in two instanced pools (max each), born once and moved by the GPU. Sparks: trucks grinding metal (a rail, coping, a car, or a ledge with angle iron or a flat bar within metalRange m of its edge), perMetre per metre ground above minSpeed m/s, thrown back at back x the grind speed plus speed m/s, up m/s, spread m/s across, falling with gravity, slowing with drag, living life s, size m wide and stretch s x their speed long, colours from white-hot to these; NPCs within npcRange m of the camera spark too. Dust: a puff on landings from minImpact m/s (count grows to the top at impactFull), bail particles on a bail, slidePerSecond off the wheels in a powerslide; spread m/s outward, rising rise m/s/s, slowing with drag, life s, growing from size[0] to size[1] m, colour and opacity; smoke: after afterTicks of powerslide, perSecond puffs of wheel smoke; grind: a slide, or trucks grinding bare concrete (not metal, which sparks), above minSpeed m/s scrapes perMetre puffs of pale grit per metre behind the board, living life s and growing from size[0] to size[1] m.
